segments.name: Wendy's U.S.
segments.description: Operates and franchises Wendy's quick-service restaurants in the United States, generating revenue from company-operated sales and franchise fees.
segments.evidence: Wendy's U.S. includes the operation and franchising of Wendy's restaurants in the U.S. and derives its revenues from sales at Company-operated restaurants and royalties, franchise fees and national advertising fund collections from franchised restaurants.

segments.name: Wendy's International
segments.evidence: Wendy's International includes the operation and franchising of Wendy's restaurants in countries and territories other than the U.S. and derives its revenues from sales at Company-operated restaurants and royalties, fees and advertising fund collections from franchised restaurants.

segments.name: Global Real Estate & Development
segments.description: Manages real estate for Wendy's restaurants leased to franchisees and earns development fees and joint venture income.
segments.evidence: Global Real Estate & Development includes real estate activity for owned sites and sites leased from third parties, which are leased and/or subleased to franchisees, and also includes our share of the income of our Canadian restaurant real estate joint venture ("TimWen").

revenueModel.text: Franchisees and company-operated restaurants pay royalties, franchise fees, advertising contributions and rent for Wendy's operations.
revenueModel.evidence: The revenues from our restaurant business are derived from two principal sources: (1) sales at Company-operated restaurants and (2) franchise-related revenues, including royalties, franchise fees, national advertising funds contributions and rents received from Wendy's franchised restaurants.

changes.text: In 2011, the company sold Arby's Restaurant Group and changed its name from Wendy's/Arby's Group, Inc. to The Wendy's Company.
changes.evidence: Effective July 5, 2011, in connection with the Company's sale of Arby's Restaurant Group, Inc., the Company's corporate name was changed to The Wendy's Company.
